gloss: the whole world; the entire world; worldwide

definitions.gloss: the whole world; the entire world; worldwide
definitions.explanation: Refers to the totality of the world without exception, emphasizing global scope. Often used in news reporting and statements about worldwide events, populations, or distributions.

examples.japanese: {全世界|ぜんせかい}が{注目|ちゅうもく}した。
この{映画|えいが}は{全世界|ぜんせかい}で{公開|こうかい}された。
{全世界|ぜんせかい}の{人口|じんこう}は{八十億人|はちじゅうおくにん}を{超|こ}えている。
examples.english: The population of the entire world exceeds eight billion people.

notes:
A compound of {全|ぜん} (all, entire) and {世界|せかい} (world). Emphasizes the totality of the world, often used in news, global statements, and dramatic expressions. Frequently appears in phrases about worldwide events, distributions, or populations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全世界|ぜんせかい}で: worldwide; across the entire world
- {全世界|ぜんせかい}に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread across the entire world
- {全世界|ぜんせかい}の{人々|ひとびと}: people of the whole world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世界中|せかいじゅう} — all over the world (more conversational, same meaning)
- {世界各地|せかいかくち} — various places in the world (emphasizes individual locations)
- {地球上|ちきゅうじょう} — on the earth (more geographic/scientific nuance)
